blind_spots.blind_spot: Public-record opacity is becoming a procurement liability just as contract sizes jump

blind_spots.why_likely_missing: An operator-founded team optimizes for mission credibility with users, not for the paper trail acquisition officials audit
blind_spots.evidence_quote: A mysterious company with no identifiable leadership or operational history won a $25M Army drone contract, raising serious red flags about defense procurement vetting.

blind_spots.why_likely_missing: R&D-contract cadence pays for builds and demos, not for the spares-and-training tail that fielding requires
blind_spots.evidence_quote: We believe in providing our employees with the flexibility to work from anywhere.
